title: Pool model: a mass preserving multi particle aggregation process
summary: We present and study the Pool model in $\mathbb{R}^2$, a rotationally symmetric analogue of Multi-Particle Diffusion-Limited Aggregation (MDLA), in which particles ("droplets") perform continuous-time random walks and are absorbed upon entering a circular pool initially centered at the origin. Each absorbed particle increases the pool's mass, and the pool expands so that its area grows accordingly, yielding a natural mass-preserving dynamics.
